name: Pont au Double
text: The Pont au Double (French pronunciation: [pɔ̃t‿o dubl]) is a bridge over the Seine in Paris, France.

depictions.name: Pont au Double
depictions.text: The Pont au Double is a bridge in Paris that connects the Île de la Cité with the southern bank of the Seine. The original Pont au Double was constructed after Francis I was asked to build a bridge that would allow for the transportation of patients to the Hôtel-Dieu in 1515. The bridge took its name from the toll that was imposed to pay for its constuction, a "double" denier.
